# Daeryun Law

> A comprehensive Korean law firm offering AI-driven legal services across corporate law, intellectual property, family law, litigation, and business advisory with offices in Seoul, Busan, New York, and Washington D.C.

Daeryun Law (법무법인(유한) 대륜) is a full-service law firm specializing in corporate legal services, AI/IT legal expertise, and 24/7 legal consultation across Korea. The firm features experienced attorneys with judge and prosecutor backgrounds and maintains strategic partnerships with academic and government institutions.

## Key Topics

- Corporate Law
- Intellectual Property
- Family Law

- Tax Law
